warnings: Multi-building drawing set (§11a): this small detached carport/canopy (โรงรถ) uses its own grid names (X1/X2 on one axis, Y1/Y2 on the other) at its own spacing, separate origin from the main house grid (หน้า00_gridline.json). Every carport view file points here via grid_source.

หน้า26's small floor-structure plan ('ผังโครงสร้างพื้น (โรงรถ)') legibly marks a beam 'B1(+0.10)' on the X1-side vertical (X1Y1-X1Y2) and 'B1'(+0.10)' on the X2-side vertical (X2Y1-X2Y2); the two horizontal edges (Y1 row and Y2 row, X1-X2) are drawn as the same double-line beam weight but no mark text was legible on this scan for those two segments specifically — assumed to continue mark 'B1(+0.10)' by symmetry with the labelled sides, not independently confirmed. Flagged rather than silently guessed.
